en.headline: Fire put out at Kai Tak public housing site, no injuries
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze on a lower floor of a Home Ownership Scheme site on Muk Lai Street on Thursday evening after multiple reports of flames and smoke.
body: A fire broke out on Thursday evening at a public housing construction site on Muk Lai Street in Kai Tak, with no injuries reported and no evacuation required, according to local news outlets citing police and fire services.

Police received multiple reports at about 8.48pm that a lower-floor unit at the site was on fire. Video circulating online showed flames and thick smoke, and residents gathered outside the hoarding to watch. Firefighters arrived with one hose and a breathing-apparatus team and put the fire out shortly afterwards.

The site is the Housing Authority's Kai Tak Sites 2B3 and 2B4, planned as a Home Ownership Scheme development known as Kai Yeung Court and scheduled for completion in 2027 to 2028. Police said the cause remained under investigation.

zh.headline: 啟德沐禮街公屋地盤起火 消防救熄無人傷
zh.dek: 周四晚上約8時48分，啟德一個興建中的居屋地盤低層單位起火，消防開喉灌救後救熄，無人受傷，毋須疏散。
body: 啟德沐禮街一個興建中的公營房屋地盤周四晚上發生火警，消防將火救熄，事件中無人受傷，亦毋須疏散。
警方晚上約8時48分接獲多個報案，指地盤低層單位起火。網上片段可見火光及濃煙，大批街坊在圍板外圍觀。消防到場後出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，未幾將火救熄。
涉事地盤為房屋委員會啟德第2B3及2B4號地盤，屬資助出售房屋項目「啟陽苑」，預計於2027至2028年度落成。起火原因仍在調查。
